scope: Synth-family offline baseline plus separately recorded device/peer-family and code-review evidence. No whole-server claim from one feature set.
acceptance: Automatic correctness commands must exit zero and execute nonempty test suites. Performance is descriptive until a paired reference exists. Device and review checks are mandatory manual evidence.

steps.instructions: Follow procedures/audio.md. Retain device/backend configuration, callback deadlines/xruns and correctness evidence. Include feature-family coverage and unsupported configurations. Offline throughput alone cannot pass this step.
Follow procedures/review.md for RT bounds, queue overflow, unsafe/FFI and lifecycle review; attach file/line evidence against the source commit.
